annotation.bound_parties_text: The Circular applies to autonomous and remotely operated ships on Norwegian domestic voyages, so it binds shipping companies/operational managers (DOC holders), shipowners and yards that must submit documentation to the Norwegian Maritime Authority.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This Circular applies to all ships with a level of autonomy equal to levels three to five (see appendix 1) that will be engaged on Norwegian domestic voyages.
